home.nearbyShopsEmptyBody: We're just getting started in your area. Check back soon, or widen your search radius.
home.setLocationPrompt: Set your location to see what's nearby
home.setLocationBody: Share your location or search for an area to find shops and services near you.

auth.welcomeBody: Sign in to order from local shops and book local services.
auth.merchantCta: Own a shop or offer a service?
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Follow it to finish creating your account.

merchant.comingSoonTitle: Merchant OS is on the way
merchant.comingSoonBody: Shop setup, inventory, and the order queue land in Phase 1–2 of the build. Your account is ready — there's just nothing to manage yet.
merchant.onboardingBody: Tell us about your business and its first location. Add products and start taking orders once an admin approves it.
merchant.pinLocation: Pin this location on the map
merchant.locationPinnedHint: {lat}, {lng} — customers will find you here once search goes live.
merchant.locationDeniedHint: Location permission denied — you can still submit; add coordinates later from the shop settings.
merchant.approvalHint: An admin reviews new shops before they go live — usually within a day.
merchant.pendingBody: An admin reviews new shops before they go live — usually within a day. We'll notify you the moment it's approved.
merchant.rejectedBody: Check your notifications for details, or reach out to support.
merchant.activeTitle: You're approved — the order queue is next
merchant.activeBody: Products, inventory, and the order dashboard land in Phase 2. Your shop exists and is verified; there's just nothing to sell yet.

admin.comingSoonTitle: Admin console is on the way
admin.comingSoonBody: Merchant approval, moderation, and platform monitoring land in Phase 9 of the build.
admin.merchantsEmptyBody: New shop applications will show up here for review.

footer.tagline: Find anything nearby. Compare. Order or book. Pick it up.
